name: EvalMockServer
description: EvalMockServer is one MCP server answered by a stand-in.

fields.name: Server
fields.description:
The directory under mocks/ the stand-in answers from: a plugin's
 server key for a plugin's case, the server's name in the turn for an
 Eval's.

fields.name: Segment
fields.description:
The name the stand-in is registered under in the turn, the real
 server's own.

fields.name: Tools
fields.description: The mocked tools; a tool not listed is not offered.

fields.name: ToolsFile
fields.description:
The server's saved tools/list response, for real descriptions and
 input schemas; empty for none.

fields.name: Plugin
fields.description: A server of a plugin the turn loads.

fields.name: Agent
fields.description: One of the evaluated agent's own servers.
